definitions.explanation: A tree that sheds its leaves annually, typically in autumn, and grows new leaves in spring.

examples.english: Deciduous trees shed their leaves in autumn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{落葉樹|らくようじゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{美|うつく}しさ→美しさ：27922_utsukushisa⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Autumn colours are the beauty of deciduous trees.
Deciduous trees have no leaves in winter, only branches.

notes:
{落葉樹|らくようじゅ} - trees that drop their leaves seasonally.

⟦{落葉|らくよう}→落葉：17301_rakuyou⟧ = leaf fall/shedding, {樹|じゅ} = tree

Common deciduous trees in Japan:
- ⟦{楓|かえで}→楓：04375_kaede⟧・⟦{紅葉|もみじ}→紅葉：05387_momiji⟧ (maple) - famous for autumn colors
- ⟦{銀杏|いちょう}→銀杏：04379_ichou⟧ (ginkgo) - yellow autumn leaves
- ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧ (cherry) - loses leaves after flowering
- ⟦{欅|けやき}→欅：27424_keyaki⟧ (zelkova)

Opposite: ⟦{常緑樹|じょうりょくじゅ}→常緑樹：04963_jouryokuju⟧ (evergreen trees)

The shedding of leaves is an adaptation to survive winter by reducing water loss and protecting against cold damage.
